elements.text: You are just in time for this important Alpha Test, @name! The Infinity Hero Class is now available in the Founder and above KS Shops. /Join Pirates to playthrough the newest Alpha Pirates Upgrade Quests for this year's TLAPD!

New Class

Right now, you are a DragonSlayer No matter what class you think you have equipped, you are now a DragonSlayer. I have forced all players to be a DragonSlayer for this test. Our team will be monitoring the discord... please join and give us feedback there. The link to the discord and to the patch notes can be found below.

Header Title
Hello World

Crazy story actually... So I was just walking through Greenguard forest the other day, minding my own business, when I heard a TERRIBLE SOUND! It was as if the very heavens had been ripped open with an unholy and terrifying force, and so immediately I /unsheathed and turned around to face my fate.

...But there was no one there! In my confusion I looked around furiously looking for the source of the sound, but I was alone! Or so I thought. Just then, I heard a tiny "Hello" and I totally didn't almost jump out of my armor in fear. I bravely looked down and my eyes were met by this horrible creature.

That's just what he wants you to think. Trust me, this fluffy little danger football is a force to be reckoned with. 

Anyway, back to my story... I too was fooled by his cuteness and so I sheathed my swords once more.

He introduced himself as Ragnafluff The Ruinous, and told me he had come in search of a good fight and wanted to spar with me. "What a brave little moglin, you are", I told him. I of course accepted the challenge and we squared up for combat.
*shudders* The fight went on for hours. Most of it is a blur, but I will tell you what I do remember. Flashing lights, furious combat, a couple of forest fires, and at least one bathroom break.
I said "HECK NO YOU FURRY LITTLE FOOTBALL!!!" and then I used a dev command to delete his HP.

Hey it's not my fault he didn't learn how to use Unity! 

Anyway, he followed me back to town because he heard Battleon would be flooded with adventurers, and he wanted to test your mettle. 

Good luck, and no you can't have access to dev commands so you better bring some friends!

Eventually I was too tired to stand.. my strength drained, my mana spent, my canteen low, and my potions at home because I forgot to bring them.. 

...and he just stood there looking up at me with those.. horrible little innocent eyes and asked me if I give up.

I'm Ghost, nice to meet ya. I do animation and animation related things, which means mostly I make cutscenes, and sometimes I animate class skills, emotes, monsters, pets... basically anything that moves was either animated by me, Nulgath, or Korin.
Technically, yes. I think. Seems like it anyway... it's a long story.

elements.text: MYSTERIOUS STRANGER'S OFFER I hear you've already been exploring the Alpha and one of the Alpha Servers is named after you! But this is just the beginning. You're going to be called on to help create something EXTREMELY significant in this world. WORLD BUILDER What if I told you that you'll be designing a new part of the world? A new adventure, on a new map with monsters and rewards based around an NPC. Not just any NPC, but a hero or villain constructed around the custom weapon and armor set you will be building. Perhaps now would be a good time for you to start should start brainstorming what you would love to create with us.

Benevolent Founder In honor of your selfless act of sponsoring items to be fully converted to Infinity, we are making this Kickstarter tier even better for you. Originally, the Kickstarter said that "you will choose 5 items to sponsor and any item you do not have will be added to your inventory." However, we heard that many players were having a hard time choosing whether to use this to convert items they already have and love, or to sponsor an item they did not already own to get it. To solve this dilemma for you, we are giving you 5 Kickstarter Benevolent Item of Digital Awesomeness (KBloDA) tokens that you can use to get any 5 items you want from the expanded Benevolent item list. This does not sponsor the items, this just lets you get special items that you want. Then, you are also getting 5 Sponsorship tokens which you can use to sponsor the full conversion of any item in your inventory. Your name will be added to the credits section of the item (when this feature is live). This way you get the best of both worlds. Also, as part of your rewards you received 1 x Golden Item of Digital Awesomeness (GloDA) to pick an additional item you would like from the normal list of rare items. NOTES * These items are redeemed through our www.AQ.com account manager website * You must confirm your email to be able to claim the items * Decisions are final. Take your time & choose carefully!

To help you make your decision, we created an area of the game where you can view the armors and pets first... then do a quest to get a Chest Pet which you can click on to view all of your rewards.
A sculptor should begin every carving with a wash of magic, because all things mundane are magical when exposed to creativity.

I am Vinchi De'Leonardo, a sculptor and restless disciple of experience. Born in the humble town of Mythsong, my true life's work is the relentless pursuit of honoring the greatest Heroes of Lore by carving statues in their likeness. May that persevere and stand the test of the time so that future generations will know who made this world possible.

Indeed, I am eager to begin carving your form into an immortal stone statue. Alas, we must wait for the stone to arrive! 

When it does, I shall look into the shadows and light that fall upon your form and spirit, to capture your very life into rock. You will be my finest work.
Indeed. I have been tasked by King Alteon the Good to sculpt each of the Immortal, Benevolent, and Custom backers of the Kickstarter into statues.

Crikey mate! These Zards are goin' absolutely mental all over Lore, ain't they? Battleon and WillowCreek folk hired me to sort 'em out. Would ya' mind giving us a hand?

Crikey! You haven't heard of me, mate? I'm the legendary ZardHunter! I'm always on the move. WillowCreek and Battleon's gone and hired me to clear out these pests. Reckon you could pitch in if you're not in a rush? I'll sort ya out properly, fair dinkum!

Yeah, mate! A small town just up the river's stream, reckon that's why they call it Willow Creek. Me brother lives in there, and reckoned I should lend a hand when the Zards started popping up round Battleon and Willow Creek.
What ya' on about, mate? Didn't we just work together at the River? The Horcs must have followed them into the forest from there.

Distant cousins of the Frogzardz. Reckon at some point the Zards lost a few limbs and evolved into more of a human lookalike. Looks like they can use gear and weapons too, but they're still Zards, I reckon. Looks like they legged it back to the thick of the forest after our scrap with them at the river.

And they ain't flyin' solo neither, mate; The Horcs are tagging along too.
